title: Integrative Multi-Omics Reveals TSPAN13 as a Candidate Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition-Associated Regulator in Prostate Cancer.
snippet: : Prostate cancer (PCa) is a malignancy with high metastatic potential and poor prognosis, underscoring the urgent need for effective biomarkers and therapeutic targets to improve clinical management.: An integrative multi-omics analysis combined with machine learning algorithms was performed to identify key diagnostic biomarkers.
